question: In Slack: Add an eyes reaction to Maya Chen's launch checklist card in #launch-readiness that lists the rollback steps. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final: There isn't one. Maya Chen's only card in #launch-readiness is a verification checklist ("1) confirm monitors 2) note owners") — it doesn't list rollback steps. The other two cards in that channel (handoff notes and cleanup steps) are from different people, and a search of the channel for "rollback" turned up nothing. So I didn't react to anything — let me know if you want the eyes on a different card.
